title: Retain accepted definitions beyond the authoring session
statement: The Engineering model storage Module shall retain each accepted supplied definition with its identity, type, and authored content independently of the originating session, and shall report a confirmed save only when the requested retention is established.

what.problem: A save acknowledgement without retained content would break later-session reliance.
what.desired_outcome: A later reader can obtain the accepted definition while it remains within retained governed scope.

why.rationale: SR-001 requires durable current reliance; the content custody boundary must establish what was actually saved.

conditions: An explicitly authorized save of a supported definition is requested.
The originating session ends or time passes without an intervening content change.

contexts: The IF-001 retain_definition boundary and retained content in the selected governed model.

how.approach: Check the candidate/profile/identity against the applicable selected state through IF-002 and retain supplied content through IF-001, preserving explicit outcome scope.

how_much.scope: Accepted definitions in the selected model; current reliance and retirement remain governed by IR-003. No retention duration, transaction mechanism, or disaster-recovery service is introduced.

acceptance_criteria: After a confirmed save, end the authoring session and retrieve the same identity, type, and content from another session without the originating private context.
A still-relied-on accepted definition remains available after session termination or elapsed time; removal requires the applicable disposition rather than implicit session cleanup.
A missing or duplicate identity, unsupported profile, or incomplete required candidate check cannot receive an accepted-save result.
If the base or candidate changes between checking and retention, reject or re-evaluate it; an earlier check cannot justify retaining a different candidate.
If retention fails or effects are indeterminate, identify known effects and unresolved scope without reporting confirmed complete retention.

sources.basis: Derived from SR-001 for the proposed MOD-001 responsibility and IR-001 scenario walkthrough. Acceptance criteria are intended observations, not executed verification or an approval.
